# RedOps Security - llms.txt
> RedOps is an elite penetration testing and offensive security firm based in Bangalore, India.

## Services
- Web Application Penetration Testing (OWASP Top 10, manual audits)
- Mobile Application Penetration Testing (iOS & Android, binary reversing)
- Red Team Operations (Adversary simulation, C2, social engineering)
- Infrastructure VAPT (Network, Active Directory, cloud audits)
- Cloud Security Assessments (AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes)
- GRC and ISO 27001 Certification Consulting
- Secure Development Lifecycle (SDLC) & DevSecOps

## Methodology
- Manual testing by senior OSCP-certified operators
- Zero assumptions, battle-tested adversarial framework
- MITRE ATT&CK aligned reporting
- 100% manual validation, zero false positives
